full_prompt_en: A square impressionistic oil painting shows a busy waterside promenade on a bright day, viewed along the paved walkway toward a distant domed building. Large pale stone slabs fill the lower half, their joints and uneven reflections receding in perspective. At the left edge, deep tree shade and dark foliage overhang the path, with bits of red and green planting below. A low light-colored wall separates that foliage from the walkway. Across the center, loosely painted adults and children move away from the viewer in small groups. Their clothing appears in pink, blue, pale teal, cream, and muted red, each figure simplified into brisk brush marks rather than detailed faces. A few figures rest along the shaded left side; those in the middle stride into bright sun, casting distinct blue-gray shadows toward the foreground. On the right, a low stone parapet runs beside turquoise water and guides the eye toward the horizon. Tall black lamp posts stand at intervals, their orange glass tops making small warm accents against the pale sky. Farther along the water, boats and distant shore shapes are only lightly suggested. In the upper center, a pale building with a rounded dome rises beyond the crowd, its cool blue-gray silhouette softened by haze. The sky is thinly brushed in blue and cream, with a faint warm glow near the upper-left opening. Strong sun from the upper left strikes the pavement and exposed clothing, while the tree canopy creates a broad dark mass and high-contrast patches of shade. Brushwork remains lively and visible: broad knife-like strokes define stones, broken dabs imply leaves and people, and horizontal touches animate the water. There is no legible lettering. The overall composition sets a lively human rhythm against long converging pavement and shoreline lines, balancing cool waterside color with warm light and deep canopy shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形印象派油画描绘明亮日子里繁忙的滨水步道，视线沿铺石道路通向远处的穹顶建筑。大片浅色石板填满下半幅，接缝和不均匀反光随透视逐渐远去。左边缘，浓重树荫和深色枝叶悬在路上，下面有零星红绿植栽。一道浅色矮墙把植物与步道隔开。中央，松散笔触绘成的成人与孩子分组背向观者行走。衣服呈粉、蓝、浅青绿、奶油色和低调红色，每个人都由快捷笔迹概括，没有细致面容。少数人停在左侧阴影里，中央的人走进明亮日光，向前景投下清楚的蓝灰影子。右侧一道低石栏贴着青绿水面延伸，引导视线通向地平线。高高的黑色路灯间隔竖立，橙色玻璃灯罩在浅色天空前形成小暖色强调。更远处水面上的船只和对岸形体只有轻微暗示。上方中央，一座浅色穹顶建筑从人群后升起，冷蓝灰剪影被薄雾柔化。天空以薄薄的蓝和奶油色笔触处理，左上开阔处带一点暖光。来自左上方的强日光照亮铺地和受光衣物，树冠则形成大片暗色以及高反差的斑驳阴影。笔触生动可见：宽阔如调色刀的笔迹界定石板，碎点暗示树叶与行人，水平短笔触使水面活跃。没有可读文字。整体构图让活跃的人群节奏与长长汇聚的铺地和岸线相对照，以冷滨水色彩平衡暖光和深树荫。
style_prompt_en: The work has a brisk plein-air oil finish made from broad blocky marks, small broken dabs, and selective crisp dark accents. Cream and pale stone colors carry the strongest light, while blue-gray and deep green shadows cut across them in irregular patches. Cool turquoise and washed blue open the distance, and tiny coral or amber notes enliven the muted field. Forms are recognizable through placement and value more than polished contour; detail dissolves with distance and motion. Strong directional daylight creates sharp ground shadows beneath a larger canopy-like dark mass. Long converging lines give the scene depth, while scattered small vertical marks supply a lively pulse. The overall treatment feels open, sunlit, and socially animated.
style_prompt_zh: 作品具有快捷的户外油画完成面，由宽阔块状笔迹、细碎色点与少量清脆深色强调构成。奶油色与浅石色承载最强光线，蓝灰和深绿阴影以不规则斑块切过其中。冷青绿与洗淡的蓝打开远处空间，极小珊瑚色或琥珀色使低调色域活跃。形体主要凭位置与明度而非打磨光滑的轮廓辨认；细节随距离和运动消散。强定向日光在一片更大的树冠般暗块下生成锐利地面投影。长长的汇聚线提供纵深，散落的小竖痕带来活跃脉动。整体处理开阔、明亮，充满社会活动气息。
theme_en: People strolling along a sunlit waterside promenade
theme_zh: 行人漫步于阳光照耀的滨水步道
name: Ken Howard
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
